contract.cache_policy: Independent identical ordered extraction per seed; no new cache sharing or precision change.
contract.utility_gate: Q-minus-uniform test full40 Macro-F1: mean>0, at least4/5 positive, paired-t two-sided95% CI lower>0.
contract.mechanism_gate: Q fixed-selected checkpoint all-test mean CE(shuffled)-CE(actual): mean>0, at least4/5 positive, paired-t two-sided95% CI lower>0; every seed uniform CE delta abs<=2e-5 and identity residual<=2e-5.

statistics.distribution_assumption: Seed deltas treated as independent approximately normal; n=5 is limited.
statistics.reporting: All5 seeds and5 conditions, failures included in status; no successful-seed dropping, rescue tuning or optional stopping. Exact sign-flip p descriptive, never claim p<.05 from five pairs.

contract.controls: Three classical/dephased contrasts descriptive attribution; unequal parameter counts; no quantum uniqueness or novelty conclusion.

trace.selection: first2 SHA256(rmea-sample-v1:split:original_id) ordered samples per train/valid/test
trace.numeric: Complete detached head input/output, selected encoder output, tokenization, classical scorer states and quantum circuit states; private loopback arbitrary-coordinate reader.
trace.boundaries: Inference replay only; no per-sample training trajectory or internal encoder-layer history claim. First-update batch parameters/gradients remain separate private evidence.

contract.lifecycle: One isolated environment/GPU preflight; one bounded canary seed29 then all5 full children serially. No partial training resume. Export-only retries use all immutable closed phases, no training.
contract.claim: Pending owner audit; no automatic L2/L3, novelty, quantum advantage or checkpoint-resume certification.
